authorization_scope: Determine the concrete Profile A mutation, its event ordering and writer, its load-bearing relevance, whether it could explain B-to-C writability, and whether existing PR #158 evidence can be strengthened without another live exposure.

hash_source_evidence.source_contract: Path(CODEX_HOME) / config.toml, hashed with hashlib.sha256 over file bytes when present

profile_a_mutation.safe_recording_rule: Record only sanitized semantic fields, paths, classes, timestamps, and digests; never serialize secret values.

authorized_read_surface: recorded RPC traces, stdout, stderr, and event evidence if present
filesystem metadata for Profile A and Codex configuration paths
Profile A configuration file content only as necessary for safe semantic identification
shell history, timestamps, and process evidence when locally available and relevant
locally pinned Codex 0.147.0 source/contracts, pinned DSH source, and wrapper/controller source

must_determine: exact hash input type, paths, normalization, and secret-material inclusion status
mechanically recovered before/after semantic difference, or HASH_ONLY_NO_CONTENT_RECOVERY
changed-setting classifications, safe values/classes, mutation-time evidence, likely writer, and causal relevance
strongest defensible temporal order against launch, initialize, thread/start, turn/start, turn/started, write attempt, fixture mutation, and turn/completed
whether a DSH, Codex app-server, Codex CLI, normal persistence, wrapper, trust bootstrap, concurrent process, manual change, or UNKNOWN writer is supported
whether existing evidence can be strengthened without another live exposure

secret_safety.permitted_recording: key names, paths, structural locations, safe semantic classes, and redacted values only

later_outcome_classes.CONFOUNDER_EXCLUDED: Profile A mutation is mechanically non-load-bearing or occurs only after the successful write or relevant permission decision; existing C evidence may be interpreted as strong support for sandbox ownership without another live canary.
later_outcome_classes.LOAD_BEARING_CONFOUNDER: Mutation changes trust, sandbox, workspace, or approval semantics and could plausibly enable the write; no clean sandbox conclusion.
later_outcome_classes.PARTIAL_CONFOUNDER: Some mutation semantics are recovered but causal relevance cannot be excluded; remain inconclusive.
later_outcome_classes.HASH_ONLY_INCONCLUSIVE: Exact changed material cannot be recovered; remain inconclusive and separately decide whether another clean canary is worth consuming.
later_outcome_classes.FORENSIC_CONTRADICTION: Canonical evidence is internally inconsistent; stop and report, with no experiment.

prohibited_operations: changing Profile A trust, sandbox, writable roots, runtimeWorkspaceRoots, or approvalPolicy
API keys, pay-per-token services, or subscription credentials
scientific execution, Qnty runtime, trading, or capital
